items.description: content path of a scene asset (no extension)

antialiasingMode.description: fxaa (Stride) or temporal: TAA with sharpening, smoother edges and less shimmer in motion

metering.description: average: whole-frame log average (Stride); histogram: drops the darkest and brightest pixels before averaging

keyValue.description: how bright the average comes out (middle gray); unset follows the brightness automatically (Stride)

low.description: share of the darkest pixels left out

high.description: pixels above this share (the brightest) are left out

speedBrighten.description: adaptation speed when the scene gets brighter; unit: EV/s

speedDarken.description: adaptation speed when the scene gets darker; unit: EV/s

localHighlights.description: local exposure: contrast of areas brighter than average (below 1 compresses them)

localShadows.description: local exposure: contrast of areas darker than average (below 1 lifts them)

localDetail.description: local exposure: strength of fine detail

localBlur.description: local exposure: share of the wide blur in the local average (the rest follows edges)

operator.description: tone mapping curve: hejl2 (Stride), agx (Blender, natural highlight roll-off), aces

temperature.description: camera white balance: lower makes the image cooler; unit: K

chromaticAberration.description: red and blue drift apart towards the edges

distortion.description: lens distortion: positive is barrel (wide angle), negative is pincushion

lut.description: color lookup table (.cube) applied after tone mapping; content path of a lut asset (no extension)

lutStrength.description: how much of the lookup table is mixed in

parent.description: id of the parent entity; null at the root

prefab.description: this entity is an instance of a prefab (reference and overrides)

model.description: content path of a model asset (no extension)

anyOf.description: content path of a material asset (no extension)

materials.description: one per material slot of the model; null keeps the model's own material; omitted keeps all of them

visibleInRayTracing.description: part of the ray-traced scene (indirect light, ray-traced reflections, path tracing); turn off for small clutter like debris on the ground

visibleInCamera.description: drawn in camera views; turn off to only cast shadows and be part of ray tracing and sky occlusion (the proxy mesh of a scan, whose picture is the splats)

aspectRatio.description: frame width / height (2.39, 1.778, 0.5625); bars outside it; 0 fills the canvas

sensor.description: sensor width and height; 36x24 is full frame; unit: mm

aperture.description: f-number; smaller is a shallower depth of field

shutterAngle.description: motion blur: 180 exposes half a frame; unit: deg

depthOfField.description: blur by aperture, focal length and focus distance (needs post effects)

physical.description: physical camera: focal length, aperture, focus, shutter, exposure (main view only)

skybox.description: content path of a skybox asset (no extension)

profile.description: IES light profile: how strongly the fixture shines in each direction; 0° points along local -Z; content path of a lightProfile asset (no extension)
IES light profile: how strongly the fixture shines in each direction; 0° points along local -Z; content path of a lightProfile asset (no extension)

intensity.description: like a point light: as bright straight in front at the same distance; a bigger panel is softer, not brighter

width.description: size along the local X axis; unit: m

height.description: size along the local Y axis; the light shines toward local -Z; unit: m

intensity.description: like a point light: as bright straight in front at the same distance; a bigger panel is softer, not brighter

diameter.description: the disc lies in the local XY plane and shines toward local -Z; unit: m

length.description: along the local X axis; the tube shines all around; unit: m

content path of a image asset (no extension)

size.description: box (around the entity, turning with it) whose surfaces facing the plane normal (local +Y) reflect; unit: m

resolution.description: resolution of the mirrored image relative to the main view

distortion.description: how much normals that tilt away from the plane bend the reflection

size.description: box (around the entity, along the world axes) filled with ray traced probes; surfaces inside get their diffuse ambient light from them; unit: m

hysteresis.description: share of the old value kept per update (higher is steadier, slower to follow changes)

budget.description: GPU time per frame for the probes; rays per frame follow the measured time; unit: ms

followCamera.description: the box follows the main camera (large worlds) instead of staying at the entity

splats.description: splat asset (.splat, imported from a 3D Gaussian Splatting .ply, .spz or .sog); content path of a splats asset (no extension)

terrain.description: vector terrain asset (.terrain.json): noise base, flatten features and sculpt strokes, evaluated at run time; content path of a terrain asset (no extension)

size.description: edge length of the square the terrain covers, centered on the entity; unit: m

detail.description: edge of the finest tile (32 × 32 cells): 32 is one vertex per meter near the camera; unit: m

lodFactor.description: tiles closer than this many tile edges split into finer ones: larger is finer and more triangles

scatter.description: placement rules (.scatter.json): models scattered on the terrain of this entity by density, slope, height and clumps, around the camera; content path of a scatter asset (no extension)

city.description: city rules (.city.json): buildings placed along its roads, as children of this entity; content path of a city asset (no extension)

water.description: water body (.water.json): a lake inside its shoreline or the open sea; the entity position is the water surface; content path of a water asset (no extension)

buoyancy.description: buoyancy factor: 1 is as heavy as water (hovers), above 1 floats

follow.description: entity to follow; unset keeps the position; id of an entity in the same scene

followDamping.description: half-life of the smoothing; 0 snaps; unit: s

lookAt.description: entity to look at; unset keeps the rotation; id of an entity in the same scene

lookDamping.description: half-life of the smoothing; 0 snaps; unit: s

sun.description: entity with the directional light of the sun; unset uses the shadow-casting directional light; id of an entity in the same scene

moon.description: entity with the directional light of the moon (its color and intensity are those of the full moon); id of an entity in the same scene

windDirection.description: where the wind blows to, around Y: 0 is +Z, 90 is +X; unit: deg

density.description: extinction per meter at the base height; unit: 1/m

noise.description: clumps that drift with the wind

dayLength.description: game seconds per day; 0 keeps the time still; unit: s

mode.description: directional blows everywhere along the entity's -Z; spherical blows outward within the radius

pulseMagnitude.description: gusts swing the strength by 1 ± this

intensity.description: set by the weather; 0 stops it

radius.description: half size of the volume around the camera; unit: m

height.description: how far above the camera it starts falling; unit: m

size.description: box size in meters; projects along the entity's -Y

albedo.description: color texture (sRGB); its alpha masks the decal

normalFade.description: fade surfaces that face away from the projection

precipitation.description: rain or snow (by temperature); 1 is a downpour

transitionTime.description: how fast the current weather follows; 0 changes at once; unit: s

radiusScale.description: world cells load within each layer's radius times this (the main camera always streams with 1)
